Resolves #20926

Unifies Workstation's visitor tour chrome around one **Start tour** button on `Workstation.view.TourToolbar`, removes the public **Start film tour** toolbar entry and `WorkspaceController#onStartFilmTour` while retaining `TourController#startFilmTour({autoGates})` and conditional **Continue** for scripted multi-window callers, guards rendered actions across both global header rows in `WorkstationTourActivationNL.spec.mjs`, and documents the header action placement rule in `apps/workstation/README.md`.

Evidence: L3 (local Chromium Whitebox E2E via Neural Link across single-window and multi-window Workstation tours + `1440x900` rendered frames) -> L3 required (AC-1..AC-4). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationTourActivationNL.spec.mjs` (keyboard `focus()` + `Enter` on `Start tour`, `alternateTourLaunchers: []`, and keyboard `Enter` advancing conditional `Continue` at a viewer gate) + `test/playwright/unit/apps/workstation/TourController.spec.mjs` (`getReference('tour-play-film') === null`) |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationTourActivationNL.spec.mjs` (`inspectGlobalHeaderActions` + `expectedGlobalHeaderActions` across Row 1 `tour-bar` / `arrangement-switch` and Row 2 `status-bar` / `topology-toolbar` on first paint, theme toggle `Light mode` <-> `Dark mode`, mid-playback, and completion `.workstation-pip-done`) |
| AC-3 | CI-covered (`WorkstationTourActivationNL.spec.mjs` live `rogue-icon-only-probe` falsifier on both `tour-bar` and `topology-toolbar` + full tour completion; `WorkstationFilmTourNL.spec.mjs` 3 tests exercising `TourController#startFilmTour` across 10 multi-window scenes) + outside-CI red-on-`dev` (`22c6162807`) proof, local `WorkstationCommitContinuity.spec.mjs`, and `1440x900` first-launch frames below |
| AC-4 | `apps/workstation/README.md` (`## Activate the visitor tour and scripted screenplays` and `## Layout controls, header action ownership, and persistence` action placement rule) paired with `WorkstationTourActivationNL.spec.mjs`; CI-covered link hygiene (`check-relative-links`) |

## Deltas from ticket
- Since `#20926` was filed on 2026-11-14, `#20910`, `#21223`, and `#21266` added the declared-arrangement switch (`Operations` and `Planning` inside `reference: 'arrangement-switch'`) to `TourToolbar.mjs`. `expectedGlobalHeaderActions` scopes Row 1 to `tour-bar` (`Start tour`, conditional `Continue`, `Light mode` / `Dark mode`) plus `arrangement-switch` (`Operations`, `Planning`), and Row 2 to `topology-toolbar` (`Reset to default`, `Undo`, `Redo`) beside zero-action `status-bar`.

## Test Evidence
- **Red-on-`dev` (`22c6162807`) falsifier (`WorkstationTourActivationNL.spec.mjs` against unpatched `apps/workstation`):** failed in `1.8s` at first-paint `inspectGlobalHeaderActions` — caught `"text": "Start dense tour"` and the extra `{ "hasIcon": true, "owner": "tour-bar", "reference": "tour-play-film", "text": "Start film tour" }` button. On the patched branch, the spec also injects and removes an icon-only `{ ntype: 'button', iconCls: 'fa fa-flask', reference: 'rogue-icon-only-probe' }` (`text: ''`) into both `tour-bar` and `topology-toolbar` to prove icon-only additions fail the check in CI on every run.
- **Outside-CI GPU Workstation continuity (`WorkstationCommitContinuity.spec.mjs`):** `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationCommitContinuity.spec.mjs` -> `1 passed (8.9s)`.
- **Local multi-window film driver verification (`WorkstationFilmTourNL.spec.mjs` via `TourController#startFilmTour`):** `3 passed (2.5m)` — all 42 beats across 10 multi-window scenes, real popup vessel births/returns, 4 real-pointer `.workstation-tour-continue` gate clicks, `autoGates: true` unattended playback, and mid-gate `cancelTour()`.

Frame critique: In the `1440 × 900` after frame, replacing the two competing start buttons with one `Start tour` action also reclaims ~`136 px` in `.workstation-tourbar`, eliminating the mid-word ellipsis truncation (`...and two th...` -> `...and two themes.`) visible in the `dev` frame while keeping `Operations`, `Planning`, and `Light mode` aligned on the right and `Reset to default`, `Undo`, and `Redo` aligned in Row 2. What could still be faulted on cold boot: the 7 unlit `.workstation-pip` track bars beneath the opening caption sit at quiet slate contrast before playback begins (lighting in cyan as `.workstation-pip-done` once beats complete), and `Undo` / `Redo` render in muted disabled contrast at `historyIndex === 0` until the first dock or arrangement commit.

*   **Patch Verdict:** Matches. `TourToolbar` drops `tour-play-film`, `WorkspaceController#onStartFilmTour` and `.workstation-tour-film` go, and `WorkstationFilmTourNL` drives `startFilmTour` over RPC. `inspectGlobalHeaderActions` maps each visible interactive element to its Neo parent (`tour-bar`, `arrangement-switch`, `topology-toolbar`) and also pins the header containers, so a new row fails too. At the head nothing outside these intended places still names the removed launcher: no `Start dense tour`, `Start film tour`, `tour-play-film`, `workstation-tour-film` or `onStartFilmTour`.
*   **Premise Coherence:** Coheres with verify-before-assert: the header rule ships with an executable contract plus its own falsifier rather than as prose alone.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge OR documented search (per guide §7.1):**

- **Challenge** (non-blocking): the PR makes one product call that the body never states. The visitor tour is the dense one, which opens no windows, and the film's ten multi-window scenes become driver-only. The ticket allowed either ("choose or combine"). The dense tour is also the frictionless choice: no pop-up permission, no gates. But window births are the Workstation's distinctive capability, and a first visitor on the lead featured card now never sees one. One sentence under Deltas would let the operator weigh that at merge. A combined sequence (the dense scenes plus one gated window beat) would be a separate design question.
- **Minor:** in `WorkstationFilmTourNL.spec.mjs`, each `filmRpc` swallows a rejection into `{rpcError}`, and the later `await filmRpc` never inspects it. The receipt assertions still fail a broken run, so this is safe. A comment on why the RPC may reject (cancel mid-gate, an RPC timeout on a long film) would save the next reader a trace.
